decision_basis: Frozen after feasibility/schema auditing and before model fitting or performance inspection. The 2025 schema and distributions were previously inspected and are disclosed; no 2025 model result exists.

temporal_protocol.final_test_rule: Evaluate frozen models once on 2025. Do not use 2025 for preprocessing fit, tuning, threshold selection or model choice.

random_reference_protocol.purpose: same-period random reference, not a deployment estimate
random_reference_protocol.future_diagnostic: After each random model is frozen, apply it once to 2025 without retuning; report separately from its internal test.

class_feasibility_preflight.interpretation: This checks only extreme sparsity and does not guarantee narrow fatal-recall confidence intervals.

training_only_operations: numeric imputation and missing-indicator fitting for linear models

planned_model_scope.rule: Any additional model is appendix-only and must be declared before its performance is inspected.

frozen_metrics.cost_matrix_note: Rows are true Minor/Serious/Fatal and columns are predicted Minor/Serious/Fatal; descriptive, not a tuning target.
frozen_metrics.bootstrap_unit: crash record, stratified by true class

directional_replication_questions.H1: Compare each metric's random-internal versus same-random-model 2025 gap; do not force a uniform optimism claim.
directional_replication_questions.H2: Compare weighted LightGBM minus weighted Logistic on random and temporal tests, including Macro-F1 and fatal-recall trade-offs.
directional_replication_questions.H3: Describe LightGBM mean-absolute-SHAP feature-rank stability between internal and 2025 cohorts using Spearman correlation.
directional_replication_questions.cross_dataset_rule: Report direction and uncertainty separately. Do not pool records, absolute metrics or claim cross-national generalizability.
